name: The Little Theatre
hours: Rehearsals most Afternoons and Evenings; Voice & Stage Presence classes for Auxiliary; shows before each festival. Lights and sound: Gani Villaluz.
sight: A jewel-box playhouse of three hundred red velvet seats, a gilded proscenium chipped at child height, and a stage that still smells of sawdust and greasepaint. Costume rails crowd the wings; a painted volcano backdrop hangs half lowered. A single ghost light burns on a stand at centre stage when nobody is rehearsing.
things: Watch a rehearsal from the back row
Be dragged on stage by Marit for 'just one line'
Try on something from the costume rail
Take the stage-presence workshop: how to stand, breathe and be looked at
Help paint flats or hang lights
Make a mask for the Night of Masks (workshop Day 53)
Stand in the ghost light alone and say something out loud
Learn to waltz, badly, before the Winter Gala
secret: Marit's kingdom and a second, gentler Nerve track: the stage-presence workshop and any performance raise it. Mask workshop Day 53; gala dance lesson Day 101; festival rehearsal Day 178. The Night of Masks pageant retells 'the Founder's shipwreck' as comedy; Chuck watches it every year from the back row and leaves before the cave scene. D54: '{H}' asks Marit, with real wonder, whether a person in a mask is 'allowed to be the other one'. She thinks it is the best thing anyone has ever said to her; she remembers it very differently later.
